name: Slow Cooker Ravioli Marinara with Mushrooms & Zucchini

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and thinly slice mushrooms. Place in a medium bowl.
Wash, dry, and trim zucchini. Halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the mushrooms.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until soft, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add marinara sauce and water to the pot, stir to combine, and remove from heat.

Coat a 4-quart slow cooker insert with a thin layer of oil. Add ⅓ of the uncooked ravioli to the insert, spreading out in an even layer, then top with ⅓ of the sauce. Finally, sprinkle with a ½-cup of cheese. Repeat twice more, finishing with 1 cup of cheese.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
18 oz cheese ravioli, fresh or frozen
2 cups shredded cheese, Italian blend

instructions.primary_message: Cover and cook until ravioli are warmed through and cheese is melted, about 5 hours on low.
When the ravioli is done, turn slow cooker off and allow it to sit for 15 minutes before serving. Enjoy!
